args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. 5 cleared, 3 flagged.
Cleared: r01, r02, r03, r04, r05. All of them pass every check that was run. r02's centre REGR peak is 112.16 %/h, about twice the batch's 53.28. Its peak position (421 µm), growth-zone length (684 µm) and flank-difference position (295 µm) match the batch, and its stride is 1, so the time base is unchanged. It is a faster-growing root, not a fault.
Flagged (summary_outlier): r06, r07, r08. Their largest flank difference is at 84 µm from the tip. Every other run has it at 295 µm. Their growth zone is also shorter: 674 µm against 684 µm.
What r06–r08 share: the same check values (rigid invariance 1.076, closure 0.453, plane-sections value 1.64) and the same profile. The difference in curvature rate between the two flanks peaks near the tip instead of in the growth zone. In r07 and r08, the width-free ratio also turns positive near the tip (+0.093 at about 50 µm; batch median −0.035).
Their checks pass, so the cause is not settled. The profile shape needs review before these strain-rate profiles are reported.
